Services

Licensed HVAC and plumbing for homes in Houston and nearby. Every job starts with a diagnosis and a written price.

AC repair & installationHeating & furnacesPlumbing repairWater heatersDrain & sewerComfort Club maintenance
01

AC repair & installation

Warm air, short cycling, iced lines, noisy outdoor unit. We find the cause and fix it, or quote a new system if repair no longer makes sense.

Call us when

  • House won't cool below 78°F
  • Outdoor unit runs but air is warm
  • Ice on the refrigerant lines
  • Power bills jumped this summer

What's included

Full diagnostic, written repair options with prices, refrigerant and electrical checks, and a load calculation before any replacement.

Diagnostic fee $89, credited toward the repair (sample terms).

CallText
02

Heating & furnaces

Gas furnaces and heat pumps: no-heat calls, ignition problems, strange smells and yearly safety checks.

Call us when

  • Furnace clicks but won't light
  • Burning or gas smell
  • Some rooms stay cold
  • Heat pump stuck in defrost

What's included

Burner and flame-sensor service, heat-exchanger and carbon-monoxide check, thermostat setup.

Smell gas? Leave the house first, then call the gas utility and us.

CallText
03

Plumbing repair

Leaks, running toilets, low pressure, faucets, disposals and slab-leak detection, done by a licensed plumber.

Call us when

  • Water stain on a ceiling or wall
  • Water bill higher than usual
  • Low pressure in one fixture
  • Toilet that won't stop running

What's included

Leak location, repair or replacement of fixtures and supply lines, shut-off valve replacement, pressure test.

We protect floors and clean up before we leave.

CallText
04

Water heaters

Tank and tankless repair and replacement, same-day when the unit is in stock.

Call us when

  • Lukewarm or rusty water
  • Popping or rumbling tank
  • Water around the base
  • Unit older than 10 years

What's included

Code-compliant install with expansion tank and pan as required, permit where required, haul-away of the old unit.

Tankless flush and descaling also available.

CallText
05

Drain & sewer

Slow drains, backups and main-line clogs, cleared with the right tool and checked with a camera when needed.

Call us when

  • Several drains slow at once
  • Gurgling sounds
  • Sewage smell in the yard
  • Backup in the lowest drain

What's included

Snaking and hydro-jetting, camera inspection with video for your records, cleanout installation.

Recurring clogs usually have a cause. We show you what we find.

CallText
06

Comfort Club maintenance

Two tune-ups a year (AC in spring, heat in fall), priority scheduling and a yearly plumbing check.

Call us when

  • System older than 5 years
  • You want fewer surprise breakdowns
  • Warranty requires yearly service
  • You rent out a property

What's included

Spring AC tune-up, fall heating tune-up, water-heater flush, whole-home plumbing check, priority booking.

From $15 a month, cancel anytime (sample terms).
